title: Adds 3D Secure exemption status to card charges
summary: The three_d_secure hash for card charges now includes an exempted field, indicating when a 3D Secure exemption has been granted.
migrationNotes: Adding an exempted field to the three_d_secure hash for card charges provides information about 3D Secure exemptions. You can now easily identify when a transaction has been granted a 3D Secure exemption.

sources.quote: | [Adds 3D Secure exemption status to card charges](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2022-08-01/adds-3d-secure-exemption-charges.md) | Payments | Breaking | api |
The `three_d_secure` hash for card charges now includes an `exempted` field, indicating when a 3D Secure exemption has been granted.
